_comment: Deterministic normalized VI Analyzer report (v2) for the result-model gate. Shape a WIN-plane parser emits from a REAL LabVIEWCLI RunVIAnalyzer ASCII report (ni/labview-icon-editor .viancfg pattern): a run summary of counts + only the failures/errors enumerated (the tool never lists passes). Content only; nothing licensed. An all-pass run is the same summary with an EMPTY findings array (see sample-report-allpass.json).
